text:
Zoe: Strange find this AM FYI Theres a syrup bottle with no pump by the sink and sticky footprints leading to the recycling bin. Also someone left three half-bagels on the counter with no note. Anyone claim? :thinking:
Ben: Not mine. I did see a coffee chain paper cup left on the bench earlier, maybe someone spilled syrup trying to be fancy. I'll bring a spare pump tomorrow.
Carla: bagels were mine  I brought them for team breakfast but was late, so I left them unlabelled. my bad.
Mateo: re: pump  there's always a spare in the top cupboard behind the oat milk. Maybe label where spares go? Also whoever knocked the syrup should clean the trail, it's sticky on the floor by the bin.
Zoe: thanks Carla for claiming. Please put future shared stuff in the "FREE" box so it doesn't confuse people. Also floor is cleaned now but if you see sticky streaks just shout and we'll handle janitorial.
Carla: will do. Sorry team! I put napkins + a note on the bagels now.
Ben: I taped a little sign to the syrup: "PUMP INSIDE CUPBOARD" and moved the spare to the shelf. Also put a small rule: "If you bring food for group, label with name and date."
Mateo: can we have a tiny sticker packet for people to mark "FREE" vs "TAKEN"? two stickers = quick decision. I'll order some and leave them by the kettle.
kitchen-bot: Quick inventory: syrup bottles (3, one missing pump), bagels (0), oat milk (2 cartons), coffee (4 bags). Low items: bagels (consumable). Suggestion: keep spare pumps in labelled box.
Zoe: stickers sound perfect. Mateo, if you order, can you also add a pack of disposable pump heads? small box goes a long way.
Mateo: yep ordering 12 disposable pumps + sticker roll. ETA Thursday.
Ben: added small laminated note to inside cupboard: ```SHARED FOOD GUIDELINES
- Label shared items with name & date
- Put extras in "FREE" box (top shelf)
- Return spare pumps to the SPOILERS drawer
- If you make a mess, wipe & shout```
